notes: Concord Smelter Mk3 (standard, 4x3, manned): three crucibles on one frame in a zig-zag (two at the back, one forward), each in a copper coil; a feed conveyor across the top from the hopper with a drop to each; heat-sink fin stacks either side of the forward crucible; armoured, bolted corners; the paint burnt off round the coils (bare steel and brown scorch). Three spouts pour into the casting line. Damaged: a fin stack is bent and glowing, the forward crucible lip is cracked and dribbles, the left coil arcs, the console bar reads red. Disabled: three cold cracked cakes, the fin stack collapsed, the feed conveyor broken and sagging, the line dead.
